scripts.build: npm run build -w @lattice/types && npm run build -w @lattice/backend && npm run build -w @lattice/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lattice/backend && npm run emit -w @lattice/backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @lattice/backend" "npm run dev -w @lattice/web"
